summary: Project Astronaut Health is an AI-powered health monitoring system designed to track astronauts' vital signs, including heart rate, SpO₂, and body temperature. It uses AI to detect abnormal health patterns, classify risk levels, and generate alerts and health insights. The solution supports early risk detection and informed decision-making, helping improve astronaut safety during space missions.
details: Project Astronaut Health is an AI-powered platform that monitors astronauts' vital signs, including heart rate, SpO₂, and body temperature. It analyzes health data to detect abnormalities, classify risk levels (Normal, Attention, and Critical), and generate alerts and AI-driven health insights. The platform helps identify potential health risks early and supports mission control in making timely decisions. Its intended impact is to improve astronaut health monitoring and safety during long-duration space missions. We used AI technologies, data visualization, and web development tools to build an interactive dashboard with an AI health assistant. The project combines real-time health monitoring concepts with intelligent analysis to address the challenges of limited medical support in space.
